def exchange(lst1, lst2):
    # Check if all elements in lst1 are already even
    if all(num % 2 == 0 for num in lst1):
        return "YES"
    
    # Check if there are enough even elements in lst2 to exchange with odd elements in lst1
    even_count_lst2 = sum(1 for num in lst2 if num % 2 == 0)
    odd_count_lst1 = sum(1 for num in lst1 if num % 2 != 0)
    
    if even_count_lst2 < odd_count_lst1:
        return "NO"
    
    # Determine if it is possible to exchange elements between lst1 and lst2 to make all elements in lst1 even
    return "YES"
